artifact_defaults.filename: Title Case without dates, workflow prefixes, or version suffixes
artifact_defaults.mastery_rule: Artifact ownership or generation is never assessed learner mastery

consult.title: Consult
consult.description: Answer a bounded bedside task or immediate clinical decision; durable capture is optional.

generate-report.title: Generate Report
generate-report.description: Create a source-traced, citation-dense neurosurgical reference report.

grand-rounds.title: Grand Rounds
grand-rounds.description: Build and validate an editable neurosurgery case or article presentation package.
grand-rounds.codex_note: Use the installed Presentations skill and its artifact-tool workflow; do not author the deck with python-pptx.

codex_ui.default_prompt: Use $grand-rounds to create a professional editable neurosurgery PowerPoint from my case material or validated Journal Club dossier, including source-traced visuals, speaker notes, package validation, and optional rehearsal.

inbox-workflow.title: Inbox Workflow
inbox-workflow.description: Triage email and draft replies with approval before any external mutation.

intraoperative-guide.title: Intraoperative Guide
intraoperative-guide.description: Create and independently review a source-grounded operative rehearsal guide.

journal-club.title: Journal Club
journal-club.description: Analyze an article into a validated, source-faithful journal-club dossier without slides.
journal-club.codex_note: Use the installed PDF skill for complete text extraction, page rendering, and visual inspection.

codex_ui.short_description: Master neurosurgery articles for journal club
codex_ui.default_prompt: Use $journal-club to analyze this neurosurgery article PDF and prepare me to defend it at journal club.

refactor-manual-note.title: Refactor Manual Note
refactor-manual-note.description: Refactor a manual Obsidian note in place while preserving its facts and attachments.

service-log.title: Service Log
service-log.description: Alias a service-rotation debrief to the Shift Debrief workflow.

shift-debrief.title: Shift Debrief
shift-debrief.description: Turn de-identified service lessons into concise, durable clinical teaching.

study-material.title: Study Material
study-material.description: Generate validated study material from a source or drill an existing note.

study-review.title: Study Review
study-review.description: Run memory-enabled Socratic review from a vault document or weak-spot queue.
